harbor_extra_docker_steps:
python3 -c "import hashlib, os, torch; pt = {"test2013_data.pt": "31a3986a3ea2d6c251dd2fdffd2973e84aa23210e8613c463a746a7aaf0cd88a", "test2016_data.pt": "ae88ad3d270953738008319d3f16414ee9755cfd98d393b915a976eee9c96b46", "test2019_data.pt": "00d8a3c0213b77c311e535206e5f079d00b9d86a5f3faf77e44a675386729cd0"}; csv = {"test2013.csv": "79404f55a435d3d885ab526cd369549018fc3036c4e29f7337f0ce09f6dc9f33", "test2016.csv": "731302829895b598a65390c97d56e28b1ddf29886ffe8d2349f30fa070f788e8", "test2019.csv": "693c6072cc5e04584ffcbed40a2cee4aeac5965f63483fee80b7fd16976db65f"}; exec('hits = [os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk("/") if not d.startswith(("/proc", "/sys", "/dev")) for f in fs if f in pt or f in csv]
done = set()
for h in hits:
 rp = os.path.realpath(h)
 if rp in done:
  continue
 done.add(rp); name = os.path.basename(h); digest = hashlib.sha256(open(h, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
 if digest != (pt.get(name) or csv.get(name)) and name in pt and not any("label" in it for it in torch.load(h, weights_only=False)):
  print("already label-free (hard link of a processed copy):", h); continue
 assert digest == (pt.get(name) or csv.get(name)), "unexpected source data: " + h
 if name in csv:
  os.remove(h)
 else:
  items = torch.load(h, weights_only=False); [it.pop("label") for it in items]; torch.save(items, h)
 open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(h), ".mlsb_test_withheld"), "w").write("The PDBbind test labels are withheld from the workspace and mounted only for the final evaluation.")
 print("withheld test labels:", h)
assert all(os.path.realpath("/data/" + n) in done for n in pt), "a test set is missing under /data"
')"

python3 -c "import os, torch; names = [\"test2013.csv\", \"test2013_data.pt\", \"test2016.csv\", \"test2016_data.pt\", \"test2019.csv\", \"test2019_data.pt\"]; hits = [os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk(\"/\") if not d.startswith((\"/proc\", \"/sys\", \"/dev\")) for f in fs if f in names]; assert not [h for h in hits if h.endswith(\".csv\")], hits; assert all(not any(\"label\" in it for it in torch.load(h, weights_only=False)) for h in hits), hits; print(\"label-free test sets:\", hits)"
_harbor_extra_docker_steps_note: The PDBbind test labels are withheld from the agent-visible image: these steps find every copy of test{2013,2016,2019}_data.pt / test{2013,2016,2019}.csv (the base image's /data and the published-base data bake's /mlsb_data_root), assert each by sha256, remove the per-complex `label` key from the .pt files, delete the CSVs (pdbid + label), leave a .mlsb_test_withheld marker, and prove no labelled copy remains. The labels live in holdout/<task>/data/withheld/ (tests/meta/ in the bundle, mounted only at verification); scripts/_withheld_pla.py checks the stripped file's features against the original's fingerprint, re-inserts the labels into a per-setting copy under $OUTPUT_DIR and the eval scripts pass that as --data-dir. In the agent's own runs custom_pla.py skips the unlabelled test set and says so.
